zh-CN.title: 前台语音通话
items: 语音通话支持全屏与折叠，聊天中保留加宽的通话记录气泡。
私聊的更多操作与可配置快捷操作均可发起通话。
拨打菜单仅保留语音通话和取消，额度与权限异常使用简洁提示。
VIP 双方各有每周五分钟额度，拨打前检查双方可用时长。

en.title: Foreground voice calls
items: Voice calls support full-screen and minimized views, with wider call-record bubbles in chat.
Start calls from direct-chat More actions or configurable chat shortcuts.
The call menu offers only Voice call and Cancel, with concise allowance and permission feedback.
Both VIP participants receive five minutes per week, checked before dialing.
